record.name: Slovakia

related_bodies.name: AI CyberLab
related_bodies.role: The ministry's project plan says research organisations develop new knowledge, models and methods, while "AI CyberLab will ensure their verification, testing and implementation support" when they are introduced into public administration information systems, from a cybersecurity perspective. The ministry's project plan says the laboratory will enable public authorities to test the security and robustness of AI solutions before they are deployed. The minutes of the Programme Slovakia monitoring committee's commission record a ministry representative saying AI CyberLab will enable verification of solutions, for example in AI, from a cybersecurity perspective and of their compliance with national and international standards.

sources.title: Market surveillance authorities under the AI Act
Zámer národného projektu: Národné laboratórium umelej inteligencie pre kybernetickú bezpečnosť (AI CyberLab)
sources.title_en: National project proposal: National Artificial Intelligence Laboratory for Cybersecurity (AI CyberLab)

excerpts.text: Výskumné organizácie vyvíjajú nové poznatky, modely a metodiky, pričom AI CyberLab zabezpečí ich overenie, testovanie a implementačnú podporu pri zavádzaní do informačných systémov verejnej správy z pohľadu kybernetickej bezpečnosti.
excerpts.gloss: Research organisations develop new knowledge, models and methods, while AI CyberLab will ensure their verification, testing and implementation support when they are introduced into public administration information systems, from a cybersecurity perspective.

excerpts.text:
Laboratórium zároveň umožní orgánom verejnej moci testovať bezpečnosť a robustnosť AI riešení pred 
ich nasadením, čím vytvára prirodzené pokračovanie výskumno vývojového cyklu smerom k reálnej 
prevádzke vo verejnej správe.
excerpts.gloss: The laboratory will also enable public authorities to test the security and robustness of AI solutions before deployment, creating a natural continuation of the R&D cycle towards real operation in public administration.

excerpts.text:
Tieto inštitúcie budú môcť do laboratória predkladať svoje riešenia, napríklad v oblasti umelej 
inteligencie, ktoré budú následne testované a vyhodnocované. Laboratórium umožní overovanie riešení 
z pohľadu kybernetickej bezpečnosti a ich súladu s národnými aj medzinárodnými štandardmi.
excerpts.gloss: These institutions will be able to submit their solutions to the laboratory, for example in the field of artificial intelligence, which will then be tested and evaluated. The laboratory will enable verification of solutions from a cybersecurity perspective and of their compliance with national and international standards.
